title: GtkBuilder UI Layout (GTK 4 + Libadwaita + GtkSource-5)
description: Generated by the Flatpak DevTools extractGtkSchema task from the GObject Introspection (GIR) files of the GNOME SDK (Gtk-4.0.gir, GtkSource-5.gir, Adw-1.gir, GObject-2.0.gir, Gio-2.0.gir). Class, property and signal names are flattened through inheritance and implemented interfaces.
